scope.firstSlice: Core producer plus independent JavaScript binary reader; no Runtime loader or VM execution
unchanged: shared scalar typeCode and validType range1..13
scope.bis: No new member is adopted by this descriptor. Any later actual member requires its concrete follow-up BIS proposal.
scope.authenticity: Packet schema/payload hashes provide exact format identity and corruption detection, not origin, signature, formal BIS membership, SourceEXE identity, semantic truth or execution authorization.

coreBinding.marker: exact tsfg_core.nullable dictionary family/version/schema/profile; verifyCandidate before serialization

command.privateInput: one fully verified marked Core candidate module on stdin; no frontend Snapshot, AST, source-file read or host-path resolution
command.privateOutput: exact one packet on stdout only after successful complete validation and bounded serialization

formal.candidateDiagnostic: [r04-core-nullable-unsupported] wire9 cannot encode a nullable candidate module
formal.order: existing parse/MLIR/Core validation occurs before this exact unsupported rejection

encoding.byteOrder: little-endian for every integer and literal; raw digest byte order is SHA256 digest order
encoding.padding: none except explicitly declared reserved bytes; no alignment padding
encoding.signedness: all integer fields unsigned except opcode1 immediate is an i32 two-complement bit pattern stored in the same 4 bytes; packed register/target fields are u16 and never signed
encoding.u64: 8 bytes;0..18446744073709551615; reader uses BigInt or exact low/high words, never JavaScript Number for all64 bits
encoding.hash32: 32 raw bytes, never textual sha256 prefix or hex
encoding.string: u32 byteLength followed immediately by exactly byteLength UTF8 bytes, no terminator; nonempty; strict UTF8/no NUL/no normalization
encoding.schemaHash: 32 raw bytes SHA256(UTF8(JCS of this complete descriptor)); freeze the exact descriptor before generating any packet; no schemaHash value field/self substitution
encoding.lengths: lengths/counts measure encoded bytes/elements, not UTF16 text units; source/function/instruction ranges alone use original UTF16 units; bounds checked before allocation/indexing/addition/multiplication

rules: Reject totalBytes above packet budget or inconsistent with actual bytes.
Payload is every byte after offset80; no trailing packet, framing or extension bytes.

orderedFields: 1..4096 UTF8 bytes; exact logical rooted slash path ending .ts but not .d.ts; no backslash, NUL, empty, dot or parent component; colon retained as logical byte
payload.capabilities: u32 field occupies inherited capability slot but is reserved0 for this private profile; old19 implies modules/authorized-host and is rejected here; no capability advertisement grants execution authority
payload.binding: Header schema binds coreBinding; no extra per-packet Core descriptor is carried. Source hash and input identity are preserved, not reconstructed from unavailable original source bytes.

orderedFields: in block order and operation order; each block contributes its declared count

roles.entry: Every parameter AND return is scalar1..13. Zero parameters do not waive return validation.
roles.internal: Parameters and result may be scalar1..13 or exact nullable241..243. Host selection must reject internal even when all types are scalar.
roles.ordering: Entry need not be function0; host default selection must use role, never blindly first function.
roles.hashBinding: Role is protected by packet payloadHash and checked as a complete table; Core candidate function identity itself does not include role.

functionDescriptor.uniqueness: Reject duplicate function IDs or exact names. Resolve all complete signatures/IDs before validating calls; forward, recursive and mutual calls are representable.

blockDescriptor.numbering: Block IDs are zero-based Core order. Register IDs are dense zero-based in block order: each block arguments first, then each result-producing instruction in that block order. Each ID defined exactly once; declared registerCount equals final count.
blockDescriptor.entry: Block0 parameters exactly match complete function parameterTypes in count/order/type; no branch may target block0.
blockDescriptor.counts: Sum of per-block instructionCount equals function instructionCount; actual stream must consume every instruction and exactly the packet.

types.privateOnly: 241..243 are valid only under this exact private descriptor; type0 exists only on br/fuel. Codes14..240 and244..255 are invalid types. Shared scalar validType remains1..13.
types.maskConversion: No implicit conversion. Calls/returns/edges use exact type equality, including mask. Only explicit retype can change mask with proof.

identity.algorithm: SHA256(UTF8(domain+NUL+prefixedCoreSchemaHash+NUL+JCS(record))); use coreBinding.schema including sha256: prefix, never private wire schema for entity identities

signatureRecord.parameters: ordered array of prefixed candidate type hashes

identity.checks: Recompute every candidate scalar and nullable type identity, signatureHash, typeId and functionId. Do not use old tsfg.type or tsfg.signature scalar-only algorithm. Raw packet hashes are converted to lowercase sha256:hex only when forming canonical records.

instruction.anchor: functionStart<=start<end<=functionEnd; original source UTF16 half-open; every instruction including fuel/branches/calls/returns has its own anchor
instruction.register: Result ID for result-producing operations; source ID for return; condition ID for cond_br; exact0 for br/fuel
instruction.packedImmediate: low16 immediate&65535, high16 immediate>>16; both u16
instruction.extensions: Only declared opcode28/32 u64 literal or opcode24/25/27 operand groups follow base16. Nullable240..244 have no extension.
instruction.unknown: Reject every unlisted opcode, extra extension or nonzero reserved field.

scalarInstructions.name: const_i32
scalarInstructions.immediate: i32 two-complement bits in immediate; no extension

scalarInstructions.name: return
scalarInstructions.type: exact function return type, scalar or nullable

scalarInstructions.name: neg
scalarInstructions.type: same integer or float as operand

scalarInstructions.name: lt
scalarInstructions.type: 2;both operands same integer or float type

scalarInstructions.name: le
scalarInstructions.type: 2;both operands same integer or float type

scalarInstructions.name: gt
scalarInstructions.type: 2;both operands same integer or float type

scalarInstructions.name: ge
scalarInstructions.type: 2;both operands same integer or float type

scalarInstructions.name: br
scalarInstructions.extension: one operandGroup; exact target parameter count/types

scalarInstructions.name: cond_br
scalarInstructions.extension: true operandGroup then false operandGroup; each exact target parameter count/types

scalarInstructions.name: fuel
scalarInstructions.immediate: exact u32 event1 entry|2 loop condition

scalarInstructions.name: call
scalarInstructions.type: exact target function return type, scalar or nullable
scalarInstructions.extension: one operandGroup; exact ordered target parameters; count<=64

scalarInstructions.name: const_integer
scalarInstructions.extension: one u64 literalBits; exact zero-extended low-width two-complement integer bits, high bits zero

scalarInstructions.name: const_float
scalarInstructions.extension: one u64 literalBits; f32 raw32 zero-extended, f64 all64 raw; preserve NaN/sign/payload

nullableInstructions.name: wrap_i32
nullableInstructions.resultTransfer: present singleton tag-set1; carrier raw32 source zero-extended to64

nullableInstructions.name: absence
nullableInstructions.immediate: u32 exact1 undefined or2 null; selected tag must belong to result mask
nullableInstructions.resultTransfer: singleton 1<<tag; carrier tag<<32, payload0, reserved high bits0

nullableInstructions.name: tag_test
nullableInstructions.immediate: low16 nullable source register;high16 exact tag0|1|2
nullableInstructions.resultTransfer: bool exact tag equality; direct cond_br predicate refines this immutable source SSA identity; testing disallowed declared tag is representable and yields infeasible true facts

nullableInstructions.name: get
nullableInstructions.proof: source possibleTags nonempty subset present{0}; no runtime speculative unbox/check substitute
nullableInstructions.resultTransfer: exact raw low32 payload as i32

nullableInstructions.name: retype
nullableInstructions.proof: source possibleTags nonempty subset allowed tags of exact result type
nullableInstructions.resultTransfer: preserve complete64 carrier and source possibleTags; no implicit conversion

carrier.present: low32 raw i32 two-complement bits; high32 zero; never sign extend i32 into carrier
carrier.absence: low32 zero; tag1/2 must be allowed by declared mask; tag3 invalid
carrier.wire: No raw nullable carrier literal encoding exists. Carriers arise only via canonical wrap/absence and exact transfers; nullable bits are never passed through scalar mask or scalar literal paths.
carrier.preservation: Future execution must copy all64 bits on branch parallel phi, call parameters, return and retype; get alone extracts low32 i32 after proof.

producer: Require exact frozen Core marker/base target/identity and verifyCandidate success before writing bytes.
Verify allowed operations/attributes, roles, complete identities/signatures, source anchors, typed SSA/CFG, dominance, fuel and complete nonempty tag proof.
Bound serialization and all temporary payload buffers; publish zero stdout bytes on any rejection.
independentReader: Read complete bytes directly without importing compiler/product modules, spawning tools or executing bytecode.

Enforce header/schema/hash/lengths, bounded record decoding, reserved fields, exact EOF, entity identities, complete roles and typed call/return/edge relations; compare instructions and tags to independent authored fixture expectations.
This test reader is structural conformance evidence, not a VerifiedModule, runtime loader, independent proof analysis or execution result.
graph: Only return2,br24,cond_br25 terminate; exactly final instruction of each block is a terminator; no earlier terminator.
Every operand must exist, have exact type and dominate its use; operation results are available only after definition, block parameters at block start.
All blocks are structurally reachable from block0; remove every block beginning with loop fuel2 and require the remaining graph acyclic.
Every function begins with exactly one entry fuel1 at block0 position0 anchored to complete function span; loop fuel2 only at nonentry block position0.

tagProof.definitions: immutable SSA register identity; no stale proof across new definitions
tagProof.branch: direct tag_test predicate filters exact operand identity on true and false edges
tagProof.phi: union actual predecessor argument sets after edge filtering
tagProof.call: result resets to full callee declaration set; no body-specialized inference
tagProof.copyReturnRetype: preserve complete carrier and proven possible tags
tagProof.fixedPoint: monotone finite dependency worklist; complete before validating proof uses
tagProof.empty: never grants get or retype proof
tagProof.cycles: retain existing entry/loop semantic-fuel and no unmetered-cycle requirements
tagProof.deadBlocks: reject structurally unreachable blocks; infeasible-edge empty facts never grant proof
tagProof.capacity: precheck bounds and capacity from verified block/register/instruction counts; at most three inserted tag bits per flow state

packetReject: wrong magic/version/schema/target/layout or nonzero reserved field
totalBytes mismatch, oversize or payload digest mismatch
invalid UTF8/NUL/path or invalid source extent
duplicate/incorrect identity/name or invalid role table/host signature
invalid block count/count sums/terminator/edge or unreachable block
missing/misplaced/duplicated entry fuel or unmetered cycle
empty/insufficient get/retype proof or analysis capacity exhaustion
verification.hostAdmissionFuture: Runtime follow-up must reject internal selection and any non-scalar complete host signature including zero-arg nullable result before initialization, memo return, State allocation/mutation or effects; TypedValue remains existing13 scalars. This descriptor does not implement Runtime admission.
runtimeConsumerFuture: Before publishing a VerifiedModule, independently verify all packet legality, identities/roles, typed SSA/CFG/dominance/fuel and the complete nonempty tag fixed point defined here; never trust the producer or payload hash as proof.
Check all raw carrier tags/reserved bits and zero absent payload at any external carrier boundary.

limits.allocation: Check remaining bytes and bounds before reserving storage; totals and dimensions use checked arithmetic. No unbounded decode/proof retries.

scalarInstructionRules.nullableUse: Only return2,call27 and branch operand groups may transport nullable types. No scalar constant/arithmetic/bitwise/equality/comparison/not/pos accepts nullable.
scalarInstructionRules.resultTyping: For comparisons18..23 the base type is bool2; derive and check equal operand scalar types from SSA definitions.
scalarInstructionRules.literalWidths: opcode28 uses widths8/16/32/64 from exact nominal integer type; signed negative narrow values are zero-extended raw low-width bits, never sign-extended to u64.
scalarInstructionRules.signedShift: Count register is i32, data type preserves nominal integer. Dynamic traps and scalar execution semantics stay existing Core semantics; reader does not execute.
